approvedBy: Claude editorial review, authorized by the owner on 2026-09-28
editionLabel: Hasbro English rules for 4+ adult players
firstPlayerRule: The rules leave it open which team goes first: players divide into Team A and Team B, and Team A chooses a player to be their first Clue-giver. The document never states how a group decides which team is "Team A."
houseFallback: This site's house-rule fallback is to pick which team starts randomly, such as a coin flip.
clarifications: It doesn't matter if one team has one more player than the other.
Team B controls the buzzer and can try to catch the Clue-giver breaking a Taboo word.

sources.title: Taboo — Rules for 4+ Adult Players
sources.location: "Setting Up Your Game" step 4, and "Taking Turns" step 1

internalEvidence: Fetched the official Hasbro-hosted PDF and extracted its text with pdftotext. "Setting Up Your Game — 4. Divide into two teams (Team A and Team B). It doesn't matter if one team has one more player than the other." "Taking Turns — 1. Team A chooses a player to be their first Clue-giver." No sentence in the document explains how the two teams are labeled A and B or which one begins.
uncertainty: The rules never specify a criterion for which team becomes "Team A" and therefore goes first; it is implicitly left to the players.
